title: Web Crawler
vague_prompt: Design a web crawler for a search engine.
hidden_guidance: Crawl 1 billion pages per month, about 400 pages per second on average
Politeness: at most one request per second to one host
Re-crawl popular pages every 24 hours and the rest every 30 days
The crawler must obey robots.txt for every host and the site terms of record
About 30 percent of fetched pages are near-duplicates of another page
The frontier must survive a worker crash without losing a queued URL
known_patterns: Frontier queue with priority by freshness and page importance
Per host politeness delay and a host level queue
robots.txt fetch and cache per host
Dedup with a Bloom filter on the URL and a content hash on the page
DNS cache to cut lookup cost
Distributed worker pool with a durable frontier store
common_misses: Crawler traps and infinite URL spaces
robots.txt cache expiry and crawl-delay parsing
One slow host blocking a shared queue
Near-duplicate detection with a simhash or shingle set
Re-crawl schedule and URL freshness score
